Will my IRA contribution be deductible?

title: If you contribute to an IRA, you can lower your taxes.
text: If you contribute to an IRA, you can lower your taxes. A great way to lower this year's taxes is to contribute to a traditional IRA or Roth retirement account. You have until April 15, 2026 to contribute for 2025. Amount you can contribute: If you're under age 50, you can contribute up to $7,000. If you're 50 or older, you can contribute up to $8,000. IRA contributions can lower your taxes if: You make a deductible traditional IRA contribution. Ex: If you're in the 22% tax bracket and contribute $1,000 to a traditional IRA, your taxes will be cut by up to $220, even if you don't itemize. You're low income, making you eligible for the Saver's Credit. The tax benefits of this are even greater. Your $2,000 contribution to a Roth or traditional IRA will lower your tax bill by up to $1,000. LEARN MORE
